summary: Wide dirt verge against bushland, cars park along it, homes across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bushland behind the verge; nearest homes are 25 m or more away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt verge about a lane wide meets the road edge, room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Two-lane suburban road with moderate traffic; van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on this verge and kerb in both Esri and QLD.

flags: Steep further north: up to 9.6% grade beyond 55 m
School zone marking at 55 m; no signs on this kerb
Low-ish ground near Witton Creek, 118 m away
sun_shade: Bush to the west shades the afternoon; the verge is open to the morning sun.
cannot_judge: Crossfall and soil softness of the verge

best_section.where: West side of Taringa Parade, north of the school zone, beside the bushland
